metadata.purpose: Sourced history of frontier and significant model availability across tracked Microsoft surfaces.
interpretation_rules: GitHub Models is not GitHub Copilot.
Foundry catalogue availability is not Copilot Studio availability.
An embedded or specialist Microsoft 365 experience is not general Copilot Chat model-picker availability.
An announcement of future availability is not first availability.
Current documentation proving support does not by itself prove the historical first-availability date.
N/F means no reliable public first date found, not unavailable.

confidence_definitions.confirmed: A primary source explicitly supports the material event date and scope.
confidence_definitions.supported: Strongly supported, but the exact first date relies on retrospective/current documentation or paired evidence.
